name: pwm-client-modern
description: Modern replacement for PWM's EOL AngularJS 1.8.3 client. Each module ships as a vanilla TypeScript Custom Element bundle for drop-in JSP embedding. Lit or Angular can be added per-module later if their template/state model is needed; the small JSP-decorating modules (changepassword, configeditor) do not need a framework.

scripts.build: ng build changepassword && ng build configeditor && ng build helpdesk && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
